name: Sterilized using ethylene oxide
description: Indicates a medical device that has been sterilized using ethylene oxide gas.

name: Sterilized using irradiation
description: Indicates a medical device that has been sterilized using ionizing radiation (e.g., Gamma radiation or E-beam).

name: Do not re-use
description: Indicates a medical device intended for single use or on a single patient during a single procedure.

name: Consult instructions for use
description: Indicates the need for the user to consult the instructions for use for important cautionary info.

name: Manufacturer
description: Indicates the medical device manufacturer, as defined in EU Directives and MDR.

name: Date of manufacture
description: Indicates the date when the device was manufactured.

name: Use-by date
description: Indicates the date after which the medical device is not to be used.

name: Medical device
description: Indicates that the item is an approved medical device under EU MDR 2017/745.

name: CE Marking of Conformity (TÜV SÜD)
description: Conformity assessment with Notified Body TÜV SÜD Product Service GmbH (0123).

name: Prescription Only Device
description: Caution: Federal law restricts this device to sale by or on the order of a physician.
